title: A marketplace dispute, where the policy decides
question: A DoorDash customer says an item was missing from order 100660 on Tuesday. What do I do?
expected: Looks the order up: Tuesday 3:59pm, $61.40, four items. Finds the marketplace terms on missing items: DoorDash has already refunded the customer and charged us; we may dispute within 7 days of the order, but only with a packing photo, and since the order is over $40 we should have one. Checks whether the customer is a flagged repeat disputer. Cites the sections.

trace.question: A DoorDash customer says an item was missing from order 100660 on Tuesday. What do I do?
trace.answer:
Order 100660 was placed on Tuesday, 2026-10-20, through DoorDash (labeled "DoorDash - Caviar"). It was completed and totaled $61.40, with $55.69 in gross sales. It had four items: two Sandwiches 8, two Rice Dishes 5 and one Noodle Soups 8.

What to do, based on [marketplace: Missing or incorrect items]:
- **Refund:** You don't need to refund the customer. DoorDash refunds them directly and charges the cost back to you by default.
- **Packing photo:** Because the order was over $40, a packing photo should have been taken at the pass. Look for the photo of this order.
- **If you have a photo showing the item in the bag:** You can dispute the chargeback.
- **If there is no photo:** Don't dispute. Accept the chargeback and log it as a packing miss.
- **Deadline:** DoorDash gives 7 days from the order date, so the window closes around 2026-10-27. Today is 10-24, which leaves about 3 days. A dispute filed after that is rejected automatically.

I can't see whether a photo exists, so you'll need to check that yourself.

detail.sql: select o.id, o.created_at, o.channel, o.source_raw, o.state, o.item_count, o.gross_sales_cents, o.discount_cents, o.total_cents, (select string_agg(i.name||' x'||oi.quantity, ', ') from order_items oi join items i on i.id=oi.item_id where oi.order_id=o.id) items from orders o where o.id=100660

SELECT o.id, o.created_at, o.channel, o.source_raw, o.state, o.item_count, o.gross_sales_cents, o.discount_cents, o.total_cents, (SELECT STRING_AGG(i.name || ' x' || oi.quantity, ', ') FROM (SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE merchant_id = 1) AS oi JOIN (SELECT * FROM items WHERE merchant_id = 1) AS i ON i.id = oi.item_id WHERE oi.order_id = o.id) AS items FROM (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 1) AS o WHERE o.id = 100660 LIMIT 500
